subject: Medford Wine and Spirits License Suspension
overview: The commission approved multiple one-day licenses and a business transfer before holding a disciplinary hearing on underage alcohol sales at Medford Wine and Spirits, issuing a 10-day license suspension.

items.title: Tufts University One-Day Licenses
items.summary: Approved two one-day liquor licenses for Tufts University events scheduled for December 5.

items.title: Winter Extravaganza One-Day License
items.summary: Approved a one-day wine and malt license for the City Hall Winter Extravaganza on December 4, subject to submission of liquor liability insurance.

items.title: Medford Arts Collaborative One-Day Licenses
items.summary: Approved two one-day licenses for Arts Collaborative events on December 12 and December 19, subject to insurance verification.

items.title: Yoki X, Inc. License Transfer and Entertainment License
items.summary: Approved the transfer of the alcohol license and granted an entertainment license for devices for Yoki X, Inc. at 62 Station Landing.

items.title: Disciplinary Hearing: Medford Wine and Spirits
items.summary: Following police testimony regarding three sales of alcohol to minors, the commission imposed a 10-day license suspension effective November 27 through December 7, 2024, and ordered employee ID and TIPS training within 60 days.
